name: Prepare a shipper authorization signature request
goal: Use the owner-provided authorization document and signer details to create a local customer-block signature request; do not sign or send it.

config.template:
Local signature request prepared from the owner-provided document. Glacier did not sign or send it. The link is available only on this Glacier machine unless the owner has configured an approved secure host.

{summary}

config.prompt: Your step: confirm the signer and owner-approved document, then give the exact signature link above to the shipper through your approved channel. Glacier has not contacted the shipper or signed anything.

acceptance.cmd: python -c "import os,json,pathlib; p=pathlib.Path(os.environ['GLACIER_HOME'])/'ventures/freight-claims/reports/signature-request.json'; d=json.loads(p.read_text()); assert d.get('url') and d.get('document_sha256') and 'signed' not in d"
